auth.panelBody: StudyHawk keeps track of Canvas and your degree plan, and answers in plain language.
auth.tip1: Ask Hawk to explain a topic step by step, then ask it to quiz you on it.
auth.tip2: Hawk has its own workspace: keep your notes and files there and pick up where you left off.
auth.tip3: Hawk runs code in its own environment, so you can test your programming practice right in the chat.
auth.tip4: Ask for a formula or a diagram: math and charts show up right in the answer.
auth.tip5: Hawk going the wrong way? Send a correction while it works, no need to start over.
auth.tip6: Upload your notes and ask for a short summary to review before an exam.
auth.tip7: Ask Hawk for a study plan for the week before an exam.
auth.tip8: Ask for practice questions or flashcards from a chapter you are reading.
auth.tip9: Turn your degree audit into a map of what is left, semester by semester.
auth.tip10: Your daily summary tells you what to focus on today.
auth.tip11: Study a little every day: ask Hawk to review yesterday's topic with you.
auth.tip12: Don't just take the answer: ask Hawk why it works and how to get there.
auth.tip13: If an answer is too short, ask Hawk for an example or a simpler explanation.
auth.tip14: Paste your solution and ask Hawk where it went wrong, not just for the right answer.
auth.tip15: Click the SH logo on the home page 10 times and see who shows up.

about.intro: StudyHawk is an academic assistant for university students. It reads your Canvas courses and your Degree Works audit and turns them into plans, study aids and straight answers.
about.modelsBody1: StudyHawk includes its own model, an open-weight model from the DeepSeek family running on our servers. It is free for students, with a daily limit. As better open models come out, we update it.
about.modelsBody2: Behind it all is PixlAI-Engine, our agent engine: it plans, uses tools like Canvas and your workspace, and keeps working on our servers. You can also connect your ChatGPT account through Codex, or use your own Claude, DeepSeek or OpenAI API key. In Auto mode, StudyHawk sends quick questions to a fast model and harder ones to a stronger model.
about.workspaceBody: Every student gets a private workspace: a small, isolated computer on our servers. StudyHawk uses it to read PDFs and Word files, run code for your assignments and keep the files it creates for you.
about.specCpuNote: Workspaces share CPU time on the same servers, up to half a core each.
about.specMemNote: Enough for documents, spreadsheets and small programs.
about.specDiskNote: Room for course files, drafts and projects. Your files stay between sessions.
about.specIdleNote: Of inactivity. It wakes up the next time you ask for something.
about.sharedBody: Giving every student dedicated cores would need a huge server farm. Workspaces take turns instead, which keeps StudyHawk free. During busy moments a heavy task may wait a few seconds in line.
about.isolationBody: Each workspace is isolated from the others and from the rest of the server. Other students cannot see your files, and you can delete them from Files at any time.
about.hardware: Everything runs on our own hardware: Intel Xeon servers, with AMD GPUs to accelerate the models. Plans with more resources may come later.
home.poweredBy: Hosted on our own Intel Xeon servers, with AMD GPUs speeding up the models.
about.backgroundTitle: Keeps working when you close the page
about.backgroundBody: Everything runs on our servers, not in your browser. Start a long task, close the tab or lock your phone, and StudyHawk finishes it. You get a notification when it is done.

admin.alertNoInstitution: No university is enabled: no email domain can sign up.
admin.alertNoModel: No model is enabled: students cannot chat until you enable one.
admin.alertCodexPaused: Sign in with ChatGPT is paused by the circuit breaker until {date}.
admin.systemHint: What is running right now. Every server shares the same database.
canvas.notConnected: Canvas is not connected yet. Add your access token in Settings > Connections.
canvas.tokenRejected: Canvas did not accept the token. It may be wrong, expired or revoked: create a new one in Canvas.
canvas.unavailable: Canvas is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
canvas.noBaseUrl: Your university has no Canvas address set up. Ask your administrator.
canvas.tokenFormat: That does not look like a Canvas access token. Copy the whole token from Canvas.
files.invalidPath: That name or path is not allowed.
files.notEditable: This kind of file cannot be edited here.
files.tempNotice: Temporary space: each file here is deleted {hours} hours after its last change. Move anything you want to keep to your workspace.
rags.title: RAGs
rags.body: Searchable indexes Hawk built from your course material, so it can answer specific questions without rereading everything. They keep the text, so the original downloads can be deleted.
rags.emptyBody: Ask Hawk to "make a RAG for ACG 2021" and it will index that course’s material.
rags.deleteBody: "{name}" will be deleted. Hawk can rebuild it later if the material is still in Canvas.
browser.invalidDomain: That does not look like a website address (for example: fgcu.edu).
browser.canvasReadOnly: Hawk never acts on Canvas: it stays read-only.
browser.sandboxBusy: Your workspace is still busy. Wait a few seconds and try again.
admin.sandboxUnavailable: This server cannot reach Docker or the sandbox image, so the agent has no code or browser tools. Mount /var/run/docker.sock into the container and restart.
admin.networkSoon: Only "open" for now: per-site filtering of sandbox traffic is planned.
browser.title: Browser
browser.body: Hawk has its own browser to use websites for you, and it remembers your logins on them.
browser.unavailable: The browser is not available on this server right now.
browser.ruleRead: Opening and reading pages never needs your permission.
browser.ruleAct: Clicking, typing and submitting ask you first, except on the sites you trust below.
browser.ruleCanvas: On Canvas it never clicks or types: Hawk is read-only there.
browser.trustedBody: Hawk can click and type on these sites (and their subdomains) without asking each time.
browser.noTrusted: None yet: every action on a website asks you first.
browser.profilesBody: Each profile keeps its own cookies. Clearing one signs Hawk out of every site in it.
browser.noProfiles: The browser has not been used yet
browser.clearBody: Hawk will forget the cookies of "{profile}" and will need to log in again on those sites.
apps.notAvailable: Coming soon: you will be able to use StudyHawk from ChatGPT or Claude. To use your ChatGPT account inside StudyHawk, go to Settings > Models.
chat.filesRootEmpty: Your workspace is empty. Files you upload or Hawk saves show up here.
chat.previewTooBig: This file is too large to preview here.
chat.previewNone: There is no preview for this kind of file.
chat.previewNotOfficeFormat: This does not look like a modern Word file: an old .doc (or another format) saved with a .docx name cannot be previewed here.
chat.previewTruncated: This sheet is large: only part of it is shown.
chat.questionsTitle: A few questions before I continue
chat.queueLabel: Next message, sent when the answer ends
chat.queuePlaceholder: Write your next message: it goes out when Hawk finishes
chat.queueHint: Enter queues it for when the answer ends. Use the square to stop.
chat.interruptPlaceholder: Write to stop Hawk and send this instead
chat.interruptHint: Enter stops the current answer and sends your message.
chat.queuedLabel: Queued: sent when the answer ends
settings.busyInputHint: What a message you send during an answer does.
settings.busyInputSteerHint: Corrects the task in progress without stopping it
settings.busyInputQueueHint: Waits and goes out when the answer ends
settings.busyInputInterruptHint: Stops the answer and sends your message instead
chat.nothingToRetry: There is no answer to try again.
chat.forkHere: Start a fork of this chat up to this answer
chat.nothingToFork: There is no answer yet to fork from.
chat.forkFromAnswer: A fork starts from an answer of the agent.
chat.forkNoRoom: There is no room in your workspace to copy this chat's files.
chat.modelLocked: The model can change when the answer finishes
chat.dictating: Listening… click the microphone again to stop.
chat.dictateDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser to dictate.
chat.dictateNoSpeech: No speech was heard. Try again.
chat.contextCompactHint: Click to compact the conversation now.
chat.contextCompactBusy: You can compact when the answer finishes.
chat.compactBody: Hawk will summarize the older messages to free space; the visible chat stays the same.
chat.backgroundTitle: Helper agents working in the background ({count})
connections.ssoTestRunning: Opening your school email to check the sign-in. If the session expired, Hawk signs in again.
connections.ssoTestDuo: Approve the sign-in on your phone (Duo).
push.invalidSubscription: This device could not turn notifications on. Try again, or use another browser.
push.invalidUrl: Use a link inside StudyHawk (starting with /) or a web address.
pushMsg.testBody: You will be told here when Hawk needs you.
pushMsg.mfaTitle: Approve the sign-in on your phone
chat.notRetryable: Only a stopped or failed answer can be run again.
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.stopBody: The agent will stop working on "{chat}". What it already did stays, but the rest of the task will not be done.
memory.howItWorks: Three short files go into every conversation: what it knows about you, its own notes, and its personality. They have a size limit so they stay useful.
memory.pausedNote: Memory is off: Hawk still reads these files but will not change them. You can still edit them.
memory.userBody: Your studies, schedule, goals and how you like answers.
memory.userPlaceholder:
Studies Accounting, junior year
Works Tuesday evenings
Prefers short answers in Spanish
memory.notesBody: Conventions and lessons it keeps for itself: what works with your courses and accounts.
memory.notesPlaceholder:
Summaries of ACG 2071 go in the course folder
Degree Works needs Duo on the first sign-in of the day
memory.soulBody: How Hawk talks to you: tone, style, what kind of study partner it is. Empty uses the default.
memory.soulPlaceholder: You are a calm, direct study partner. Keep answers short, use steps and tables, and push me to finish things early.
tiers.invalidLimit: One of the limits is out of range.
tiers.invalidPrice: The Stripe price id looks like price_...
tiers.needsDefault: There must always be a default plan. Make another plan the default first.
tiers.priceTaken: Another plan already uses that Stripe price.
billing.notForSale: That plan cannot be bought right now.
billing.alreadySubscribed: You already have a subscription: change it from "Manage subscription".
billing.stripeFailed: Stripe did not answer as expected. Try again in a minute.
billing.invalidKey: That does not look like a Stripe key (sk_..., rk_... or whsec_...).
billing.keysFirst: Save the Stripe secret key and the webhook secret before turning payments on.
plan.computeLine: {day} Compute Units a day, {week} a week
plan.checkoutSuccess: Payment received. Your new plan turns on in a few seconds.
plan.paymentFailed: Your last payment failed. Your plan stays until {date}; update your card in "Manage subscription".
plan.endsOn: Your subscription is cancelled: your plan ends on {date}, then you go back to the free plan.
admin.helpersHint: Helper agents one delegation can start at the same time.
admin.helperDepthHint: How many levels helpers may delegate again. 0 turns delegation off.
admin.computeHint: 1 CU = one core busy for an hour. Each window starts with the first use. 0 = unlimited.
admin.limitsInPlans: CPU, memory and disk are set per plan: each student's sandbox starts with their plan's limits.
admin.messagesInPlans: Daily messages with the StudyHawk model are set per plan.
chat.badAttachments: Attachments must be up to 10 files from your Files.
chat.resizeFiles: Drag to resize the files panel (double-click to reset)
admin.mcpCodeRuns: Code runs per day from apps
